indicators.name: Population, total
indicators.label: Populasi
indicators.definition: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. The values shown are midyear estimates.
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
indicators.label: PDB per kapita
indicators.definition: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. The core indicator has been divided by the general population to achieve a per capita estimate.This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: GDP growth (annual %)
indicators.label: Pertumbuhan PDB riil
indicators.definition: Gross domestic product is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. This indicator denotes the percentage change over each previous year of the constant price (base year 2015) series in United States dollars.
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
indicators.label: Pengguna internet
indicators.definition: Internet users are individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months. The Internet can be used via a computer, mobile phone, personal digital assistant, games machine, digital TV etc.
indicators.sourceOrganization: World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, International Telecommunication Union (ITU), uri: https://datahub.itu.int/
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Food imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicators.label: Porsi impor pangan
indicators.definition: Food comprises the commodities in SITC (Rev. 3) sections 0 (food and live animals), 1 (beverages and tobacco), and 4 (animal and vegetable oils and fats) and division 22 (oil seeds, oil nuts, and oil kernels). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise imports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a non-resident and a resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: Food exports (% of merchandise exports)
indicators.label: Porsi ekspor pangan
indicators.definition: Food comprises the commodities in SITC (Rev. 3) sections 0 (food and live animals), 1 (beverages and tobacco), and 4 (animal and vegetable oils and fats) and division 22 (oil seeds, oil nuts, and oil kernels). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise exports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a resident and a non-resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: Agricultural raw materials imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicators.label: Porsi impor bahan baku pertanian
indicators.definition: Agricultural raw materials comprise section 2 of SITC Rev. 3 (crude materials, inedible, except fuels) excluding divisions 22 (oil-seeds and oleaginous fruits), 27 (crude fertilizers and minerals excluding coal, petroleum, and precious stones), and 28 (metalliferous ores and scrap). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise imports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a non-resident and a resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: Agricultural raw materials exports (% of merchandise exports)
indicators.label: Porsi ekspor bahan baku pertanian
indicators.definition: Agricultural raw materials comprise section 2 of SITC Rev. 3 (crude materials, inedible, except fuels) excluding divisions 22 (oil-seeds and oleaginous fruits), 27 (crude fertilizers and minerals excluding coal, petroleum, and precious stones), and 28 (metalliferous ores and scrap). This indicator is expressed as a percentage of merchandise exports which is comprised of goods whose economic ownership is changed between a resident and a non-resident and that are not included in the following specific categories: goods under merchanting, non-monetary gold, and parts of travel, construction, and government goods and services n.i.e.
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: Service imports (BoP, current US$)
indicators.label: Impor jasa
indicators.definition: Imports of services are services provided by non-residents to residents. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
indicators.sourceOrganization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: Service exports (BoP, current US$)
indicators.label: Ekspor jasa
indicators.definition: Exports of services are services provided by residents to non-residents. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
indicators.sourceOrganization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: ICT service exports (BoP, current US$)
indicators.label: Ekspor jasa ICT
indicators.definition: Information and communication technology service exports include computer and communications services (telecommunications and postal and courier services) and information services (computer data and news-related service transactions). Data are in current U.S. dollars.
indicators.sourceOrganization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: ICT service exports (% of service exports, BoP)
indicators.label: Porsi ekspor jasa ICT
indicators.definition: Information and communication technology service exports include computer and communications services (telecommunications and postal and courier services) and information services (computer data and news-related service transactions).
indicators.sourceOrganization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)
indicators.interpretation: Historical trade proxy; not an active purchase order or available stock.

indicators.name: School enrollment, tertiary (% gross)
indicators.label: Partisipasi pendidikan tinggi
indicators.definition: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown. Tertiary education, whether or not to an advanced research qualification, normally requires, as a minimum condition of admission, the successful completion of education at the secondary level.
indicators.sourceOrganization: Data API, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources, note: The data are obtained through the UIS API.  Detailed documentation is available at: https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/documentation/, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), type: Bulk file (csv), date accessed: 2026-03-19, date published: 2026-02
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)
indicators.label: Belanja pemerintah untuk pendidikan
indicators.definition: General government expenditure on education (current, capital, and transfers) is expressed as a percentage of GDP. It includes expenditure funded by transfers from international sources to government. General government usually refers to local, regional and central governments.
indicators.sourceOrganization: Data API, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources, note: The data are obtained through the UIS API.  Detailed documentation is available at: https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public/documentation/, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), date accessed: 2026-03-19, date published: 2026-02
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Labor force, total
indicators.label: Angkatan kerja
indicators.definition: Labor force comprises people ages 15 and older who supply labor for the production of goods and services during a specified period. It includes people who are currently employed and people who are unemployed but seeking work as well as first-time job-seekers. Not everyone who works is included, however. Unpaid workers, family workers, and students are often omitted, and some countries do not count members of the armed forces. Labor force size tends to vary during the year as seasonal workers enter and leave.
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicators.label: Tingkat pengangguran
indicators.definition: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
indicators.sourceOrganization: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.

indicators.name: Labor force participation rate, total (% of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicators.label: Partisipasi angkatan kerja
indicators.definition: Labor force participation rate is the proportion of the population ages 15 and older that is economically active: all people who supply labor for the production of goods and services during a specified period.
indicators.sourceOrganization: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026
indicators.interpretation: Country or sector context; not a measure of active demand or available supply.
